entity.name: Matthew Busel / Tensorust LLC
entity.description: Tensorust LLC is a New York company owned and run by Matthew Busel, who writes and maintains its open source libraries: fin-primitives (exact-decimal trading indicators for Rust and Python), llm-prices (a dated, source-cited LLM API price table), us-restricted-parties (US restricted-party lists as daily machine-readable releases) and sbom-attest (build-time SBOMs and provenance for Rust and C/C++). Funding pays for maintainer time: releases, bug fixes, security work, documentation and keeping data current. More at https://tensorust.com

projects.name: fin-primitives
projects.description:
Checked building blocks for trading code in Rust, with Python bindings: exact decimal price and quantity types, a level-2 order book, ticks to OHLCV candles, 700+ streaming indicators that match TA-Lib to 2e-11 or better on the shared set, Black-Scholes Greeks, a position ledger and risk limits. Bad values, such as a negative price, are rejected at construction instead of flowing into results.

Published on crates.io and PyPI (wheels for Linux, macOS, Windows and WebAssembly) through trusted publishing with PEP 740 attestations. Used as the RSI and technical-indicator dependency of ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis.

plans.name: Maintenance grant
